rationale: Keeps the base year auditable

value: Weighted-average cost per available unit; cost of revenue = units sold x average cost
rationale: Absorption costing: unsold production goes to inventory instead of the P&L

value: See Assumptions tab section A (9 drivers x Downside/Base/Upside) with rationale per row
rationale: Anchored to Microchip reported history (Assumptions section B)

value: MCU 0 pts / Analog & power -5 pts / FPGA +5 pts vs division demand growth
rationale: Creates realistic mix shift for the Phase 4 mix variance

value: Monthly factors 0.96-1.08 (sum = 12.00); quarter-end pulls and a December dip
rationale: Typical semiconductor shipment pattern

value: R&D $200m (20% of revenue); SG&A $100m (10%)
rationale: Division excludes corporate overhead that sits in Microchip's company-wide ratios (23.0% / 14.3%)

value: DSO 60 days on revenue; DPO 40 days on variable manufacturing cost; inventory from Ops_Model
rationale: Microchip DSO 55-69 days FY2022-FY2026

value: 30% of fixed manufacturing cost is depreciation; FY2027 capex depreciated straight-line over 60 months starting the month after spend (in cost of revenue)
rationale: ~7% of revenue vs Microchip ~5.5% (D&A less intangibles amortization) in FY2026

value: No division-level interest; tax = scenario rate x pre-tax income each month (tax paid as expensed; loss months give a credit)
rationale: Financing and tax payments are managed at corporate

value: Budget = Base scenario computed from the Base column of Assumptions (locked; independent of the selector)
rationale: A budget is set once and does not move with forecast scenarios

value: Demand vs budget +4% / -6% / +12%; ASP vs base year -2.0% / -0.5% / +2.0%; yield 92.5% / 93.5% / 82.0%; utilization 82% / 76% / 88%; variable cost +4.5% / +4.0% / +6.0%; fixed cost $9.6m / $5.1m / $4.6m per month (MCU / Analog / FPGA); R&D $18.0m and SG&A $8.4m per month; capex 2.6% of revenue; monthly demand noise 0.99-1.02
rationale: Designed to show a realistic mix of favorable and unfavorable variances incl. an FPGA yield problem

value: Price = Ua x (ASPa - ASPb); volume = change in total units x budget average price; mix = change in mix x total Ua x ASPb; profit bridge uses budget gross profit per unit; material, yield, fixed spending and absorption/inventory computed from production data
rationale: Standard FP&A decomposition; volume and mix use units summed across product lines

value: FPGA automated final-test platform: $24.0m equipment + $3.0m installation; +0.30m units/month test capacity; +3 pts FPGA yield; $1.5m/yr operating savings; $1.2m/yr maintenance; 6-year life, no salvage; max practical utilization 90%; FPGA ASP erosion 2%/yr after FY2027
rationale: Targets the FPGA yield and capacity constraint visible in the operating model and variance analysis

value: Discount rate 9%; approve criteria per scenario: NPV > 0, IRR >= 11% hurdle, payback <= 4.0 years. Rule: reject if Base fails; approve outright only if Downside also passes; otherwise approve with a demand checkpoint
rationale: Microchip does not report a WACC; 8-11% is a common semiconductor range
